an4.40:1.1: Then the brahmin Udāyī approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
an4.40:2.4: The prose portion is identical with that of AN4.39.
an4.40:3.2: When a sacrifice is timely and allowable,
an4.40:3.4:
the self-controlled followers of the spiritual life
attend such a sacrifice as this.
an4.40:4.1: Those in the world who have removed the coverings,
an4.40:4.4:
the Buddhas who are proficient in sacrifice,
praise this kind of sacrifice.
an4.40:5.2: whether of the ordinary kind or in memory of the dead,
an4.40:5.3: one makes the sacrifice with a confident mind
an4.40:5.4: to a fertile field, to followers of the spiritual life.
an4.40:6.1:
When what has been properly obtained
is properly offered, properly sacrificed,
an4.40:6.3: the sacrifice is vast and the deities are pleased.
an4.40:7.1: The wise person endowed with faith,
an4.40:7.2: having sacrificed thus with a generous mind,
an4.40:7.3:
is reborn in a happy world,
in a realm without affliction.
